summary: Build the worker operation request panel
objective: Implement the production worker operation request panel and deterministic render tests exactly as frozen in docs/CR5D_INITIAL_WORKER_UI_CONTRACT.md section 3. The component requests intent only and may not imply that an operation was authorized or applied.
semanticAcceptance: The component matches contract section 3, renders only server-supplied request choices, preserves disabled choices and reasons, and labels every operation as a request.
Render tests cover worker state and reason, all three operation labels, disabled controls, authority/confirmation text, semantic structure, and safe escaping.
The implementation performs no authority decision, optimistic state change, command construction, approval, authentication, audit, network request, effect, or dashboard integration.
stopConditions: Stop if the contract requires editing any path outside allowedPaths or inventing client-side authority rules.
Stop before changing CSS, dashboard pages, backend routes, domain state, policy, protocol, persistence, dependencies, or architecture.
Stop before any install, download, native command, service, credential access, external effect, or production mutation.
